title: GTA 6 Broke 3 Records in One Week
short_title: GTA 6 broke 3 records in one week #GTA6 #Shorts
short_title_options: GTA 6 broke 3 records in one week #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
Three records from GTA 6's first week: the biggest entertainment launch ever ($3.79 billion in pre-orders plus day one, per Take-Two; Forbes called it the largest entertainment launch ever); the highest Metacritic score ever (99, tied with Zelda: Ocarina of Time); and the biggest Twitch peak for a single game (about 3.3 million viewers, beating League of Legends' 3.11 million). Which record falls next?

Sources: Take-Two 8-K, Forbes, Hungarian Conservative, VGC, Notebookcheck, Dot Esports, Insider Gaming, Wccftech.
